notes.title: 🔔 If you are interested - pay attention to us!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!
This isn’t a big update — more like a small wave to anyone passing by 👋
We’re already testing our game on Steam. Every day, we break things, fix things, add new stuff, and check old features. Just today, we tested P2P connectivity via Steam_Lobby. Yep, the game already connects through Steam and we’re steadily progressing!

This post is less about patch notes — more of a signal:
If our game interests you, please wishlist it on Steam! 💙
It really helps, especially before release.
And hey — if you tell your friends, or even make a TikTok with the hashtag #RustRides, we’d be thrilled.

We truly believe our project deserves your attention. We’re putting both heart and tech brain 🧠 into this.
[hr][/hr]🛠️ A quick look at the technical side:
Solid optimization, even for weaker PCs.

Have an older GPU? We’re adding AI frame generation for smoother gameplay.

Have RTX? Enjoy full ray tracing support.

Don’t have RTX? No worries — it’ll still look great.

Our settings are flexible, adaptive, and designed for comfort.
[hr][/hr]
💬 Thanks for reading!
Be patient just a bit longer — we’ll deliver a cool, stable, and stylish game just for you.

With love,
The Rust Rides Dev Team
